sources.scope: Named intersection point catalog. Complete query provenance for all8batches is in retrieval-manifest.json.
limitations: Independent of OSM but related to City street-centerline lineage; do not count as a second independent City survey.
Last published data modification is2023-03-28, not a guarantee of current2026conditions.
Contains self-road and ramp-name records; catalog point is not individual lane or source-node proof.
No grade, legal access, oneway or permitted-turn attributes.

sources.provider: City of Fremont Public Works / Transportation Engineering
sources.scope: City implemented protected-intersection project locations; Status and Status2 retained.
limitations: Physical named-junction and at-grade design corroboration only for Status=Implemented, with no inference about every carriageway approach.
One In Design/Fully Funded project is excluded from implemented evidence.
Project-point geometry can share City GIS lineage; engineering implementation status provides additional independent subject evidence beyond line proximity.
No intersection-specific current signal/turn-control plan or permitted movement list.
Generic motorist guidance explicitly warns to check whether right turns on red are prohibited.

sources.scope: Official National Bridge Inventory, dataset asof2025-06-20; boundedFremont-area extract.
limitations: FHWA aggregation of jurisdiction-submitted bridge records; do not count Caltrans and NBI reproductions as two independent sources.
Bridge-point location is not exact deck footprint, ramp topology or turn permission.
Facility-carried and crossed-feature names may be historical, including AutoMallParkway overI680. Retain source wording.
Raw direction/open status codes are retained; no whole-route driving permission is inferred.
